fields.description: Human-friendly name, e.g. Singapore. The record's Name (e.g. ap-south-1) is the provider's own region code, and is what Grove sends to the API.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: Ingestion endpoint for agents in this region, e.g. https://metrics.ap-south-1.example.com/v1/write. Keeps a region's samples off a cross-region hop. Blank = the fleet-wide URL in Grove Settings.
fields.label: Remote Write URL

fields.description: AWS region name the latency record set measures resolvers against, e.g. ap-south-1. Only a reference point, so a box in a region AWS has none of names the nearest one. Defaults to this record's own name when that is already an AWS region.
fields.label: Latency Reference

fields.description: Route53 calculated health check over every gateway in this region, at threshold 1 — the region is up while any one of them is. What the region's latency row is health-checked by.
fields.label: Health Check ID
